name: Deepforge Arbalest

attributes.description:
The deep forge gave its limbs a second voice.

Ricochet: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to strike one enemy beside your target for 65% physical attack damage, up to 36. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
